description: FindWeedNY's cannabis glossary: ~300 terms for products (live rosin, badder, distillate), cannabinoids and terpenes (THCA, total THC, myrcene), lab testing and COAs (LOQ, action limit, remediation), contaminants (pesticides, solvents, heavy metals, mycotoxins), New York law (CAURD, microbusiness, possession limits, home grow) and shop slang (420, eighth, preroll). Each definition is written for New York, cites primary sources for legal claims, and many carry an "In New York" note and buying tips. Lab terms carry counts from tens of thousands of New York certificates of analysis (how often an analyte is tested, detected, and failed). Pass a term, alias, or misspelling; an exact match returns the full entry, otherwise the closest terms come back in `matches`. Use it for "what is X", "what does X on my label mean", or "is X legal in New York" questions.

term.description: The word or phrase, e.g. "THCA", "live resin", "LOQ", "CAURD"

name: define_term

dataUpdated.description: ISO timestamp of the feed this result came from: dispensary directory (OCM refresh), deals export, brand-availability export, or review index

matches.description: Closest terms when there is no exact match, or other senses when there is

source.description: Attribution line — CC BY 4.0, cite the row url

labData.description: New York COA counts from the CheckWeedNY database

detected.description: COAs where it was found above the lab's reporting limit

newYork.description: How the term applies under New York rules

title: Define a cannabis term
